description.en: Curious and quick. Hops between cards and waves when you look her way.
description.zh: 好奇又轻快，在卡片之间蹦来蹦去，你看她时会挥手。

description.en: Warm and drowsy. Naps on sunny cards and stretches when she wakes.
description.zh: 暖洋洋、懒洋洋，在晒得到太阳的卡片上打盹，醒来伸个懒腰。

description.en: Bright and quick, with a cup of milk tea never far away. Loves to run and hop around.
description.zh: 机灵爱笑，手边总有一杯奶茶，喜欢跑来跑去、蹦蹦跳跳。

description.en: Sunny and outgoing. Waves at everyone, jumps the highest, and blows bubble gum when she gets bored.
description.zh: 阳光外向，见谁都挥手，跳得最高，无聊了就吹泡泡糖。

description.en: Curious about everything. Hops from card to card with her camera and snaps whatever catches her eye.
description.zh: 对什么都好奇，带着相机在卡片之间跳来跳去，看到喜欢的就拍下来。

description.en: Quiet and polite. Sits down for a cup of tea and floats down gently under her umbrella.
description.zh: 安静有礼貌，喜欢坐下来喝杯茶，掉下来时会撑开小伞慢慢飘落。

description.en: Calm and gentle. Finds a quiet edge, sits down, and reads along with you.
description.zh: 安静温柔，找个安稳的边角坐下，陪你一起读。
